summary: @ken_bauer https://david.shanske.com moved the publishing portion of Bridgy into semantic linkbacks I think? In terms of backfeeding you can still install the Bridgy plugin. I did not know Bridgy was pulled from the main #IndieWeb plugin. Will check with David.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @ken_bauer https://david.shanske.com moved the publishing portion of Bridgy into semantic linkbacks I think? In terms of backfeeding you can still install the Bridgy plugin. I did not know Bridgy was pulled from the main #IndieWeb plugin. Will check with David.
